Grant GFDRR-VN-2026-003 ($1.40M) quantified wave-height attenuation of 55% to 72% across 250-meter Avicennia-Rhizophora mangrove belts paired with porous sediment-trapping fences, reducing concrete revetment toe-scour maintenance costs by 39% across a $315.0M World Bank coastal resilience lending operation.

Grant GFDRR-KEN-2027-021 ($1.55M) designed vegetated bioswales, constructed riparian wetlands, and vetiver road-cut stabilization, informing $260.0M in World Bank Urban Mobility & Flood Resilience financing.
Sub-catchment peak discharge fell by 27% in instrumented pilot reaches, protecting 3,400,000 urban commuters and riparian residents (RF-2030-IND-02).

Under GFDRR Results Framework indicator RF-2030-IND-02 (people with reduced flood risk from risk-informed investments), the combined grey-green embankment setback package targets 6,400,000 beneficiaries by FY2029, reducing modelled 25-year agricultural inundation duration from 49 days to 18 days. Benefit-cost ratio (BCR) across three wetland corridors was estimated at 3.4x under RCP4.5 monsoon intensification.
